       (rc.compliance_data->>'prev_viol')::int as prev_viol,
       (tr.trader_fin_data->>'age_days')::float as age_days,
       rc.compliance_data->>'comp_rate' as comp_rate
FROM traders tr 
JOIN trade_records trd ON tr."TR_KEY" = trd.tr_anchor 
JOIN market_conditions mc ON trd."REC_KEY" = mc."REC_PIN"
LEFT JOIN reg_compliance rc ON mc."REC_PIN" = rc."REC_COMP"
WHERE tr."typeFlag" = 'Institution' AND (rc.compliance_data->>'prev_viol')::int = 0 LIMIT 5;

WITH trader_compliance AS (
    SELECT tr."TR_KEY", 
           AVG((rc.compliance_data->>'prev_viol')::int) as avg_prev_viol,
           AVG((tr.trader_fin_data->>'age_days')::float) as avg_age_days,
           AVG(CASE rc.compliance_data->>'comp_rate'
               WHEN 'A' THEN 1.0
               WHEN 'B' THEN 2.0
               WHEN 'C' THEN 3.0
               WHEN 'D' THEN 4.0
               ELSE 2.5
           END) as avg_grade_val
    FROM traders tr 
    JOIN trade_records trd ON tr."TR_KEY" = trd.tr_anchor 
    JOIN market_conditions mc ON trd."REC_KEY" = mc."REC_PIN"
    LEFT JOIN reg_compliance rc ON mc."REC_PIN" = rc."REC_COMP"
    WHERE tr."typeFlag" = 'Institution'
    GROUP BY tr."TR_KEY"
),
trader_network AS (
    SELECT rel_root, circ_size as network_strength
    FROM trader_relationships
)
SELECT tc."TR_KEY" as trader_id,
       ROUND(CAST(1.0 / (1.0 + (tc.avg_prev_viol / NULLIF(GREATEST(1, tc.avg_age_days / 365.0), 0)) * tc.avg_grade_val) AS numeric), 4) as compliance_health_score,
       tn.network_strength
FROM trader_compliance tc
LEFT JOIN trader_network tn ON tc."TR_KEY" = tn.rel_root
ORDER BY compliance_health_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT tr."TR_KEY", 
       rc.compliance_data->>'prev_viol' as prev_viol_raw,
       CAST(rc.compliance_data->>'prev_viol' AS integer) as prev_viol_int
FROM traders tr 
JOIN trade_records trd ON tr."TR_KEY" = trd.tr_anchor 
JOIN market_conditions mc ON trd."REC_KEY" = mc."REC_PIN"
LEFT JOIN reg_compliance rc ON mc."REC_PIN" = rc."REC_COMP"
WHERE tr."typeFlag" = 'Institution' AND tr."TR_KEY" = 'TR41689';
